text_block_list.text:
It's summer, and preparations for the
autumn
Tenno Sho are underway.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин is more focused than
ever,
determined to achieve the feat of
successive wins
in both the spring and
autumn races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Filled to the brim with motivation, she
begins her
final summer camp!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
